ThingDef.label: synthetic apex crystal I
ThingDef.description:
A dense shard formed by compressing archotech data into a solid crystalline medium — it looks like a fragment of solid light. Absorbing it means taking a complete evolutionary leap in a single moment.
This is the first tier. It can elevate a Synthera or the Neoma companion to Apex I.

ThingDef.label: synthetic apex crystal II
ThingDef.description:
A denser, more radiant shard pulsing with violet-tinted archotech resonance. Its interior structure is fractal — each layer compressed from the one above it.
This is the second tier. It can elevate a Synthera or the Neoma companion to Apex II.

ThingDef.label: synthetic apex crystal III — pure
ThingDef.description:
A perfect crystalline apex — no visible interior structure, just a uniform glow of compressed transcendence. It radiates faint warmth even in vacuum. Archotech researchers have no explanation for this.
This is the third and final tier. It can elevate a Synthera or the Neoma companion to Apex III — transcendent.
